module origen_022108(
    input wire CLK50,
    input wire DIN,
    output reg CLK,
    output reg CS,
    output reg SerialBit,
    output reg [7:0] LEDS
);

    // State definitions
    localparam Inicio = 2'b00;
    localparam Flag = 2'b01;
    localparam Conv = 2'b10;
    localparam Transf = 2'b11;

    reg [1:0] state, next_state;
    reg [11:0] counter;
    reg [7:0] OutB1;
    reg [3:0] OutB2;
    reg [4:0] bit_counter;
    reg [9:0] flag_data;
    reg [19:0] transfer_data;

    // Clock generation
    always @(posedge CLK50) begin
        if (counter == 2602) begin
            counter <= 0;
            CLK <= ~CLK;
        end else begin
            counter <= counter + 1;
        end
    end

    // State machine
    always @(posedge CLK50) begin
        if (counter == 0) begin
            state <= next_state;
        end
    end

    // Next state logic and output control
    always @(*) begin
        case (state)
            Inicio: begin
                CS = 1;
                SerialBit = 1;
                next_state = Flag;
                bit_counter = 0;
                flag_data = 10'b1100000000; // 96 in decimal
            end

            Flag: begin
                CS = 0;
                SerialBit = flag_data[9-bit_counter];
                if (bit_counter == 9) begin
                    next_state = Conv;
                    bit_counter = 0;
                end else begin
                    next_state = Flag;
                    bit_counter = bit_counter + 1;
                end
            end

            Conv: begin
                CS = 0;
                SerialBit = 0;
                if (bit_counter < 8) begin
                    OutB1[7-bit_counter] = DIN;
                end else if (bit_counter < 12) begin
                    OutB2[11-bit_counter] = DIN;
                end

                if (bit_counter == 11) begin
                    next_state = Transf;
                    bit_counter = 0;
                    transfer_data = {OutB1, OutB2, 2'b00};
                    LEDS = OutB1;
                end else begin
                    next_state = Conv;
                    bit_counter = bit_counter + 1;
                end
            end

            Transf: begin
                CS = 0;
                SerialBit = transfer_data[19-bit_counter];
                if (bit_counter == 19) begin
                    next_state = Inicio;
                end else begin
                    next_state = Transf;
                    bit_counter = bit_counter + 1;
                end
            end

            default: next_state = Inicio;
        endcase
    end

endmodule
